title: Something New in the Woods
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Marta Fenwick has hunted around Pinewatch for twenty years. The giant spiders that moved into Silkfall Hollow are new to her, and she wants to know what their bite does.

About

Given byMarta Fenwick
Level11
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Silkfall Venom Sac ×3

Steps

  1. Talk to Marta Fenwick to get the quest.
  2. Giant spiders in Silkfall Hollow (8)
    Silkfall venom sacs (3) - Silkfall Venom Sac at -281, -213

Rewards

Reward
Gold448
Character XP14,000
Quest points1

What Marta Fenwick says

Marta Fenwick: Careful with those. Set them on the bench. No, don't touch your eyes.

Marta Fenwick: It stiffens the muscles first and stops the heart later. A deer has a few hours. A man, maybe a day.

Marta Fenwick: I'll make up an antidote. Bryn ought to hear about this. His crew won't cut near that hollow, and now I know why.

Handing it in

"I'll make up an antidote. Bryn ought to hear about this. His crew won't cut near that hollow, and now I know why."
